records.title_zh: 七部门部署京津冀美丽中国先行区建设
records.title_en: Seven departments issue an action plan for the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Beautiful China pilot zone
records.summary_zh: 行动方案提出绿色低碳转型等六方面二十二项任务，到2027年区域细颗粒物年均浓度降至33微克每立方米，主要污染物排放和碳排放强度继续下降。
records.summary_en: The plan sets 22 tasks across six areas including green and low-carbon transition. By 2027 it targets annual average PM2.5 of 33 micrograms per cubic metre alongside continued declines in major pollutants and carbon intensity.

records.title_zh: 新型能源体系建设“十五五”规划发布
records.title_en: China issues its 15th Five-Year Plan for a new energy system
records.summary_zh: 规划统筹新能源规模化发展、电力系统调节能力、能源安全与绿色低碳转型，是观察中国未来五年能源结构和技术部署的核心政策文件。
records.summary_en: The plan coordinates large-scale new-energy development, power-system flexibility, energy security and low-carbon transition, making it a central policy document for China's next five years of energy-system development.

agencies.name_zh: 美国能源部储能办公室
agencies.name_en: US Department of Energy Office of Electricity

records.title_zh: 2025年全球新增电池储能装机108吉瓦
records.title_en: Global battery storage additions reached 108 GW in 2025
records.summary_zh: 国际能源署统计显示，2025年全球新增电池储能装机同比增长40%，磷酸铁锂约占部署量的90%，储能成为增长最快的电力技术。
records.summary_en: IEA data show that global battery storage additions rose 40% in 2025 to 108 GW. Lithium iron phosphate supplied about 90% of deployments, making storage the fastest-growing power technology.

records.title_zh: 2025年全球数据中心用电量增长17%
records.title_en: Global data-centre electricity use rose 17% in 2025
records.summary_zh: 国际能源署指出，人工智能专用数据中心用电量在2025年增长50%；电网接入、供电可靠性、能效和储能配置成为数据中心扩张的关键约束。
records.summary_en: The IEA reports that electricity use by AI-focused data centres rose 50% in 2025. Grid connections, reliable supply, efficiency and storage are becoming critical constraints on expansion.

records.title_zh: 国际能源署发布《能源与人工智能》报告
records.summary_zh: 报告建立全球和区域数据中心电力需求模型，分析人工智能对能源安全、排放、创新和可负担性的影响，并讨论供电、能源与电网配置。
records.summary_en: The report models global and regional data-centre electricity demand and assesses implications for energy security, emissions, innovation and affordability, including options for power supply and grids.
